title: Add the missing real-tree Fact for the file-row settle branch (root-level stale hardlink file, per O-018)
how_to_read: Each attempt is one line and a `details` filename in this same directory. Open a detail file ONLY when this index points you at one -- the summaries are here so you do not have to. `caused_by` is what sent the stage back; `changed` is what the attempt then touched, counted by kind. Several attempts in a row that were caused by the same stage and changed no `src` is a loop, not progress.

open.issue: observed: Assert.True() Failure at FileRowRevisedGuardTests.cs:99: "of 344 test units in tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests read, 0 build a hardlinked name directly under the scan root that is grown through another name and then scanned, and none of them asserts that File row Revised."

C1 (derived from the title and the 'Expected' line): tests/FsAnalyser.Core.Tests has a real-tree Fact that hardlinks a name directly under the scan root to a file in a subfolder, grows the file through the subfolder's name, scans, and asserts the root-level File row is Done at the grown size with Revised true: missing

C2 (derived from 'nothing guards it'): the default suite fails when the file-row half of the latch is broken, i.e. a mutant `r.Kind != EntryKind.File &&` at TopLevelTracker.Build's latch is killed: missing

Where the mutant-A kill lives. Chosen: a one-off check in a disposable copy at build and validate, following Mutants.ps1's safety discipline but adding nothing to it. Alternative: add a TopLevelTracker entry to SL-102's Mutants.ps1 ValidateSet roster so the kill is repeatable. Lesson #428 says 'apply mutants only through Mutants.ps1'. Against that, the roster is SL-102's last-access set, and widening it changes what SL-102's 'All' run means.

Whether the Fact belongs in HardlinkTests, next to ALoneNameUnderTheRootIsChargedAtItsOwnSize, which already builds the root-level stale shape. It is placed in TopLevelTests because Watch and its watcher are private there, and the guarded behaviour is the top-level row, not the hardlink charge.
